Class OrderRepository

  • Method Details

    • submit

      public OrderRepository.OrderReceipt submit(OrderRepository.OrderRequest request) throws IOException, SQLException
      Saves an order and deducts stock atomically using current database prices. Runs blocking work and must be called off the JavaFX thread. A return value confirms commit; if the connection fails during commit, reconcile the outcome before retrying.
      Parameters:
      request - validated order details; must not be null
      Returns:
      the committed order receipt
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if employee, menu, toppings, or stock checks fail, or a transaction operation fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if the request is null or calculated amounts exceed database limits

    • submit

      public OrderRepository.OrderReceipt submit(OrderRepository.OrderRequest request, Map<Integer, BigDecimal> quotedPrices) throws IOException, SQLException
      Saves checkout and stock deductions in one transaction, rejecting stale quoted prices. When a quote is supplied, it must contain every ordered drink at its current base price. Topping prices and availability are always checked. A lost connection during commit can leave an uncertain outcome that must be reconciled before another submission.
      Parameters:
      request - validated order details; must not be null
      quotedPrices - displayed base prices keyed by menu item identifier, or null to skip base-price comparison
      Returns:
      the receipt after commit completes
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if checkout validation fails, stock is insufficient, a conflict occurs, or persistence fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if the request is null or calculated amounts exceed database limits
      NullPointerException - if a supplied quote contains null keys or values
